newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bastia airport freight and mail up in Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Bastia airport freight and mail up in Jan-Oct.

text.p: Bastia's Poretta airport handled 1,621 tonnes of airfreight in the first ten months of 1996, an increase of four percent on the same period last year.
Air France Europe is the principal airline operator at Bastia with daily passenger services between Paris-Orly and the northern Corsican city using Airbus 320 series aircraft.

Bastia is also served by French airline, Air Littoral which, using one of its five-tonne capacity HS748 aircraft, operates an all-cargo charter service on behalf of French parcel delivery groups, Calberson and Sernam.
The HS748 flies a nightly Marseille/Bastia/Ajaccio/Marseille itinerary.
Jan-Oct postal traffic handled at Bastia totalled 4,844 tonnes, up 10 percent on 1995 levels, the airport authority said.
French carrier, L'Aeropostale, carries postal freight between its Paris-CDG hub and Bastia using Boeing 737QC (quick change) aircraft. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
